notes: Photocell-triggered red-light trial. First credible red/yellow requests 1400us for 350ms immediately. Neutral 1500us is then held for at least stop_confirm_s; timing completion is separate from physical or visual stop verification. Supplementary braking requires 200ms neutral settling followed by at least 3 distinct fresh ground frames spanning 200ms of continuous motion. Duplicate, stale or isolated motion frames do not request supplementary braking. Confirmed sliding is not cleared by unknown feedback; 300ms continuous still evidence clears it. At most 6 brake requests per round, including pre-red motion recovery. Formal red and a fresh same-source green window remain required. Standalone green action is speech-only; competition proceeds through the existing stage transition. Saved forward PWM is floored to 1570us and capped by the traffic approach limit. No external gate or metric wheel-position sensor is connected; elapsed time and pixel motion do not prove physical stopping distance.
